title: The Charcoal Burners
text: Charcoal burners tend their smoking mounds in a clearing, black to the elbows, coughing. The trees around them are dead. They watch you come with red-rimmed eyes and hands on their axes. They do not like strangers, and they like nobles less.

options.label: Help them tend the smoking mounds, and earn a little of their trust.

outcomes.text: It is smoky, choking work. At the end they share their supper, their charcoal and a little of their silence.

options.label: The best talker wins them over, despite their dislike of nobles.

outcomes.text: They tell you which paths the wood keeps, which it lets go and which it never gives back.

options.label: Pass by their mounds, and leave them to their axes and their smoke.

outcomes.text: Their eyes follow you out of the clearing, their smoke further still. By dusk everyone is coughing.
